overlap_details: The numbered callout circles ② and ③ slightly overlap the top outlines of the Q,K and V boxes, respectively. No text, legend, or other annotation is clipped or colliding.
issues: Callout markers ② and ③ sit partially over the top borders of their corresponding boxes.
The orange and yellow-gold annotation colors are somewhat similar, especially for viewers with color-vision deficiencies.
suggestions: Move callout circles ② and ③ slightly upward or increase the spacing above the Q,K and V boxes.
Increase the hue or lightness contrast between the orange ① and yellow-gold ③ markers, or supplement the distinction with different marker shapes or line styles.
